subject: CAIQ control mapping & evidence handoff — LedgerLabs assessment
messages:
From: Priya Singh <psingh@ledgerlabs.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: LedgerLabs Security Team <security@ledgerlabs.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ scope and evidence packaging for upcoming assessment

Hi Grace —

Thanks again for taking the call yesterday. As discussed, LedgerLabs is preparing a scoped CAIQ/CSA review for our upcoming procurement window. We want to validate your control mappings and a short set of runtime samples (log lines, key rotation evidence) before the security committee meeting on May 3.

Attached is a high-level scope doc from our side (small SOW). Our ask: can you provide a CAIQ mapping that matches controls to artifacts, a named owner for each control, and examples of telemetry/log samples for the runtime (1–2 short files)? We prefer a single condensed workbook if possible.

Please confirm timeline — target turnaround from Redwood: 5 business days. Also: is DocuSign approval required for the evidence transfer? We have internal legal constraints on how attachments are exchanged.

Appreciate it — Priya

Attachment stub: ledgerlabs_scope_v1.pdf (pdf)

--
Priya Singh
Head of Technical Sourcing | LedgerLabs
psingh@ledgerlabs.com
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: CAIQ scope and evidence packaging for upcoming assessment

Team — forwarding LedgerLabs request. They want a condensed CAIQ crosswalk, owner roster, and a small runtime log sample within 5 business days. Legal wants DocuSign for evidence transfer.

Proposed split:
- Marissa: take the CAIQ crosswalk workbook and populate control->artifact mapping (I created a workbook template).
- Karthik: validate the technical assertions and provide the runtime log sample (anonymized) + short note on KV cache/key rotation cadence.
- Priya: owner roster and KMS/HSM attestation pointers (links to internal runbook).

I can package and run the DocuSign envelope once we have the workbook. Can we hit draft by EOD Wed (4/21) so we can review before sending out?

Thanks — Grace

Attachment stubs: redwood_caiq_template.xlsx (xlsx)

--
Grace O'Connor
Director, Security & Trust Operations | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 11:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ scope and evidence packaging for upcoming assessment

Grace, all —

Uploaded initial draft: redwood_caiq_crosswalk_v1.xlsx (tabbed: Summary, ControlMapping, Artifacts). Quick notes:
- I mapped every CAIQ question we think will be in-scope (LedgerLabs scope doc attached) to our standard artifacts. Where we couldn't provide a live sample I flagged for collection.
- Karthik: I put placeholders on controls related to runtime encryption and cache isolation (CM-6 / CW-5 style). Can you drop the runtime_log_sample.txt into the Artifacts tab and add the short operator note about rotation cadence (one paragraph).
- Priya: owner roster in control_owner_roster.csv — please add emails and secondary owners.

We should keep evidence small: sample files only, don't export full log streams. For DocuSign, legal prefers we bundle a short evidence transfer attestation PDF and route only the hashed artifacts through the DocuSign envelope. I will prepare the envelope once the artifacts are attached.

ETA: I'll have my pass at the owner roster and the condensed summary by EOD today.

Attachment stubs: redwood_caiq_crosswalk_v1.xlsx; control_owner_roster.csv

--
Marissa Cole
Principal, Compliance Programs | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Priya Singh <psingh@ledgerlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, LedgerLabs Security Team <security@ledgerlabs.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: RE: CAIQ control mapping & evidence handoff — LedgerLabs assessment

Hi Priya —

Thanks for the patience. Attached is our condensed CAIQ crosswalk and the requested artifacts for review: redwood_caiq_crosswalk_v1.xlsx, control_owner_roster.csv, and a short runtime sample (runtime_log_sample.txt). Per our conversation with Legal, we are transferring evidence via DocuSign link to satisfy ledger transfer requirements — the envelope contains an evidence transfer attestation and hashes of the attached sample artifacts. Please confirm receipt and whether you want the full workbook in a single merged PDF or the native workbook.

DocuSign link (expires in 7 days): https://app.docusign.com/cla/Envelope12345678

Quick highlights from the crosswalk:
- We link CAIQ control SC-3 to our KMS rotation playbook (owner: Priya Natarajan).
- Runtime telemetry examples included for cache eviction and KV-store TTL events (anonymized).
- Where LedgerLabs required tenant-residency evidence, we've annotated alternative mitigations for Dedicated vs Hosted deployments.

Next steps: once you sign the envelope we will deliver the zipped sample artifact bundle via the secure SFTP channel you provided (security@ledgerlabs.com). If legal needs any redlines on the transfer wording, loop in your counsel and we'll coordinate.

Best,
Grace

Attachments (sent via DocuSign envelope): docusign-caiq-approval.pdf (pdf - attestation), redwood_caiq_crosswalk_v1.xlsx, control_owner_roster.csv, runtime_log_sample.txt
